policy: reservation-policy.v1 - mechanically derived from the execution shape the runner permits, priced at catalogue rates

turnsPerConversation.from: DEFAULT_TOOL_BUDGET.maxToolCalls (8, compiler/semantic/types.ts) + MAX_TURN_OVERHEAD (4, caller.ts module-private, mirrored and pinned by test)

firstTurnInputTokens.from: MAX_FIRST_TURN_INPUT_TOKENS (shard-planner.ts): the planner bounds a shard first turn to half the 200k window

outputTokensPerCandidate.from: min(480 s x 125 tok/s, min(model.max_tokens, 128000)); the wall-clock ceiling wraps the whole compile (Pass A + shards); output is the only rate-bounded term

inputTokensPerTurn.from: firstTurnInputTokens + toolRetrievedSourceTokens + outputTokensPerCandidate (prior assistant turns re-sent)

conversationsPerCompile.from: NO runner-side cap exists (the certified planner decides the shard count; one re-execution per shard on SHARD_PROVIDER_FAILURE). Harness-declared cap = the population-observed maximum over 72 billed compiles (retries included); ENFORCED: telemetry beyond the reserved shape stops the run (RESERVATION_SHAPE_EXCEEDED) before another dispatch

passACalls.from: inventory.ts batchChars default 6000: one first-pass call per batch plus at most one gap-pass call per batch; each bounded by firstTurnInputTokens

verifierCalls.from: reviewer.ts (1 call site) + condition-suspicion-classifier.ts (1 call site); each bounded by firstTurnInputTokens; output bounded as above

hardInvariant: before every dispatch: committed (exact + retained + outstanding) + next reservation <= ceiling, and committed + next < STOP_AT; refused => BUDGET_STOP before the request begins

settlement.exact: reservation replaced by the exact charge, unused part released
settlement.zeroToken402OrRefusal: PROVIDER_REFUSED_NO_COST: $0 exact, reservation released; nothing was served, nothing billed
settlement.partiallyServedThen402: EXACT from provider telemetry, then the run stops

consequenceForRecovery: with $1.462384 left under the population ceiling, the compile reservation ($1.3513292) admits exactly one further dispatch. At concurrency 1 a recovery mission needs its ceiling to exceed committed + one candidateMaxReservation ($1.3929292) at every dispatch; N candidates need a ceiling of roughly N x their exact costs + one reservation, not N x reservation.
